text:
omar_sales: Quick pass - handing Sparrow to CS after signed contract. Private deploy (VPC), SSO + SCIM, requested 99.9 SLA, 8-week go-live target. Procurement flagged an external security assessment that could delay renewal conversations. @maria_csm youre primary onboarding owner. Contract + notes: https://redwood.example/sparrow/contract

maria_csm: Got it. I'll own kickoff. Tentative customer kickoff Tue 3/28. Need infra prerequisites and a primary infra contact from the customer. Marking renewal risk as "monitor" until procurement gives a review window.

jess_eng: Engineering notes: private control plane deploy, SCIM connector, initial DB snapshot for onboarding data. Unknowns: customer CIDR for peering, KMS vs HSM decision, expected peak QPS. Rough estimate: 2 sprints for work + security signoff.

liam_support: Support asks: runbook, post-launch health checks, escalation list, and monitoring dashboard. Recommend a dedicated #sparrow-support channel (internal) and a customer notification list for incidents. I can draft the runbook template.

devops_bot: JIRA created CS-4821: "Sparrow - private deploy provisioning" assigned to sam_ops. https://jira.redwood/browse/CS-4821

sam_ops: Taking provisioning. Need CIDR, peering contact, and egress rules. ETA to provision staging infra: 5 business days after CIDR is provided.

maria_csm: Internal owner summary:
- Onboarding lead: @maria_csm
- Eng owner: @jess_eng
- Ops/provisioning: @sam_ops
- Support/runbook: @liam_support
- Sales/AE: @omar_sales

Short next steps:
1) Maria to collect CIDR, KMS preference, and SSO metadata from customer by 3/24.
2) Sam to provision staging (5 business days after CIDR).
3) Jess to size SCIM connector and schedule dev sprint; needs sample user CSV and peak QPS.
4) Liam to start runbook and monitoring template.
5) Omar to chase procurement for the security review timeline and share any requested attestations.

omar_sales: I'll ask procurement and ping the customer for sample users and SSO metadata this afternoon. Noted historical security reviews often take 4-6 weeks.

jess_eng: For SCIM, a sample CSV with header helps. Preferred header: `email,external_id,first_name,last_name,groups`. Also need SAML metadata XML or IdP metadata URL.

liam_support: I'll add SLA expectations and on-call contacts to the runbook skeleton. Suggest adding a D+7 quick health check and D+30 deeper review.

maria_csm: I'll create an internal #sparrow-launch channel and invite engineering/ops/support. Customer invited after legal approves shared docs. Will update this thread with kickoff invite.

omar_sales: Procurement note: if they request vendor attestation (SOC2), we may need legal/Compliance to provide docs; that could push renewal/contract timeline. Marking renewal risk as medium and will escalate if review extends.

jess_eng: FYI if customer opts for on-prem HSM integration, add ~2 weeks for key provisioning and validation. I've flagged this dependency in CS-4821.

sam_ops: Also need customer's infra lead for peering tests and traceroutes. Please include contact and timezones in the kickoff invite.

maria_csm: Thanks. I'll confirm owners and schedule. Reassign tickets if anything changes. :thumbsup:

liam_support: Copy. I'll post the runbook draft in the channel when ready and link the monitoring dashboard template.

deploy-bot: Reminder posted: add post-launch health checks at D+7 and D+30 to product calendar.

maria_csm: Closing this handoff thread. Will reopen if blockers appear before kickoff. Thanks everyone.
